name: Villager Jobs
description: Villagers farm, tend animals, haul between chests, craft at a chest and gather the wild pickables around it. K on a villager, then on a chest, opens the job wheel. Saved per world. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Job key
settings.help: Look at a villager and press it, then hold it while looking at a chest.

settings.label: Seconds per crafted item
settings.help: For recipes without their own crafting time.

settings.label: Gather rest (s)
settings.help: A gathering villager rests this long after each pickable it brings in.
